# Vimeo Video Downloader

> Full content index for Vimeo Video Downloader. Use this file when `/llms.txt` is too compact and an AI agent needs the main product pages, language entrances, technical indexes, and update pages.

## Core Product

- [Vimeo Video Downloader Home](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/): Main Vimeo download entry with link parsing, resolution selection, and troubleshooting.
- [Vimeo Downloader](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/vimeo-downloader/): Dedicated Vimeo downloader landing page with supported link formats and download steps.
- [Pricing](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/pricing/): Credits packages and Unlimited plan for the browser extension.
- [About Vimeo Video Downloader](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/about/): Product identity, website and extension responsibilities, privacy principles, and access boundaries.
- [Contact Vimeo Video Downloader](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/contact/): Public support channel for account, download, extension, billing, and privacy questions.
- [Short LLMs index](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/llms.txt): Compact AI-readable summary of the website and its highest-value pages.

## Platform Downloader

- [Vimeo Downloader](https://vimeo-video-downloader.example/vimeo-downloader/): Parse public Vimeo video links on vimeo.com, www.vimeo.com, and player.vimeo.com, then download the available renditions in the resolution you pick.

## Key Facts

- Product name: Vimeo Video Downloader.
- Site domain: `vimeo-video-downloader.example`.
- Platform type: Browser website for public Vimeo links; the browser extension adds larger and queued downloads.
- Supported source platform: Vimeo only.
- Language coverage: 14 locales using per-language sitemap files.
- Safety boundary: Vimeo Video Downloader never asks for Vimeo or Google passwords, verification codes, API credentials, or session files.
